fields.Name: T261 - Knowledge Analytics Tab Navigation and KPI Drilldown
fields.Description: Exercises the analytics dashboard's section rail + KPI/widget drill-down (OpenDrillDown/CloseDrillDown) — a bespoke charts-and-drilldown surface distinct from every other KH tool.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Analytics' in the left nav (fa-chart-line icon). The Analytics screen has a left-nav rail with sections (Overview, Tags, Sources, Pipeline, Quality, Cost & Usage). Confirm the Overview section renders its KPI cards and widget grid, then click a different section (e.g. Tags or Quality) and confirm the main content swaps to that section. Also, on Overview, click a KPI card and confirm a drill-down detail panel opens (with a table or a 'No data available' empty state). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Analytics Overview renders KPI cards and a widget grid, and switching sections in the rail swaps the main content
Clicking a KPI card opens a drill-down detail panel (table or valid empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
